output.summary: The 95% green dashboard is unreliable. Status is self-reported with no objective criteria, and bonuses reward green. Audit found 4 of 6 green projects behind, and customers escalated before projects turned amber. Platform delays on CSD work are largely CSD-caused: late, incomplete specs, with 58% returned versus 15-19% elsewhere. Complete, early requests land 87% on time. Platform capacity is a modest secondary factor. Participation decline is CSD-specific. Whether the SVP directed inflation is unestablished. Preferred: objective status criteria plus the bonus metric change. Transferring engineers, penalty SLAs, removing the SVP, and de-anonymizing survey authors are not justified or are harmful.
